text:
**Thursday**, with the talk behind you. Tae Kwon Do is early today, at 4:00, so it is straight from school to the mat.

Pre-Comps are under four weeks out, and review week starts **December 7**. Tonight, spend ten minutes writing the list rather than doing the work: every topic in each class you would want another look at before then. A list made early is a plan. A list made in December is a panic.
